label: Vietnam
short_description: Loyalty-program hotels the length of Vietnam -- Ho Chi Minh City and Hanoi, the Da Nang-Hoi An coast, and the Nha Trang and Phu Quoc beach resorts.
intro: Vietnam's coverage in this directory runs the length of the country: Ho Chi Minh City in the south, with riverside towers and District 1 city hotels; Hanoi in the north, around West Lake and the western business districts; the central coast at Da Nang, from the Han River city center to the beach resorts toward Hoi An; the south-central beach city of Nha Trang and the Cam Ranh resort strip; and the island of Phu Quoc, with beach resorts along its western and southern coasts.
